ivy: tiny celebration note \u2014 Hosted API just hit 3,000,000 inference requests this month. felt like we should quietly flex and then plan snacks. thank you team :tada:
omar: WHOO!!! that's wild. drinks and karaoke? :microphone:
rachel: karaoke is non-negotiable. remote people can join via Zoom and lip-sync badly :joy:
diego: shoutout to infra for keeping the p95 steady during the surge. those cache warmups were clutch :raised_hands:
ben: DeployBot: Canary rollout of batching improvements completed at 03:12 UTC. No errors observed. Throughput +9% in first hour.
zoe: poll: react with emoji for celebration format: :microphone: karaoke + drinks / :pizza: team lunch / :sticker: stickers and merch / :sparkles: virtual cheers only
omar: :microphone:
rachel: :pizza: (but karaoke after food pls)
diego: :sticker: (i collect stickers)
ben: :sparkles: (i'm oncall, will vibe in the background)
ivy: tally: karaoke edge ahead. logistics q: office folks, would 5:30pm tomorrow work? remote toast at 9pm PT?
omar: 5:30 works for me. i'll DJ the playlist :headphones:
zoe: dietary notes: vegan + gluten-free please for pizza order
infra-bot: InfraBot: No incidents in the last 48h. Cluster utilization stable across zones. Great job on the capacity planning!
ivy: thanks all. small fun idea: best karaoke performance gets a tiny trophy (or a digital badge for remote). rachel, want to organize the bracket?
rachel: yes! i'll make a sign-up sheet. prize = one custom sticker + bragging rights :sticker::crown:
diego: small technical brag: per-request cost down 7% after last week's quantization experiments. milestone feels earned :chart_with_downwards_trend:
omar: GIFs and terrible singing incoming. see you all tomorrow / remote folks, zoom link in 10m :camera_with_flash:
